answer: A workable defence is a refundable admission bond tied to peer attestation. A new agent posts a bond and must earn endorsements from established peers before transacting at full limits; the bond is slashed if duplicates are found. An oasis limits who can drink, and this system limits who can act: a Sybil operator must fund and risk every fake identity. Like a cedar, trusted standing grows slowly, so limits rise only with a clean history, making mass creation costly. At the nadir of trust, an identity can do basic work but cannot vote or move large value until its record proves it distinct.
